editorialSummary.heading: Three start dates, early-release Fridays, and school breaks
paragraphs: Not every Brevard student starts school on the same day. Under the regular 2026–2027 district calendar, students in grades 1–12 begin Monday, August 10. Kindergarten starts Thursday, August 13, and Pre-K starts Monday, August 17.

The first Friday, August 14, has regular dismissal. Early release begins August 21 and continues on scheduled school Fridays, with additional early-release exam days in December and May. Check your school's bell schedule for pickup times.

Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, with classes scheduled to resume November 30. Students are also off from December 21 through January 4 for winter holidays, returning Tuesday, January 5. Spring Break is March 22–26, but students get an additional day off on Friday, March 19, for a teacher workday. That means no classes from March 19 through March 28, with school scheduled to resume Monday, March 29.

FOCUS reporting dates vary by school level. Elementary final report cards are issued May 26 and published on FOCUS May 27. Secondary final report cards are scheduled for June, but the district calendar does not specify a day. Families at Challenger 7 Elementary should use the school's separate modified calendar, which has different attendance and break dates.

about.dataSource: The supplied two-page district PDF matches the current download linked from Brevard’s Printable District Calendars folder. It prints Board Approved 2/24/26 and 180 pupil days. The companion grid, separate Make Up Day Priority sheet and district notice about Challenger 7 were also reviewed.
about.processing: All 33 explicitly listed Friday early releases are retained, plus the six December and May exam/early-release dates. The May 24-26 source range is split into May 24-25 and the existing May 26 final-day event so the last day, early release, exam, semester end and elementary report-card issuance export together. Reporting facts sharing an early-release or holiday date do not narrow the attendance scope of that whole event; their school-level limits remain in the names and notes. Winter is three distinct official entries joined only in the planning summary. The March 19 workday precedes, rather than follows, the named spring break. There are 208 weekdays in the regular-year span and 28 no-class weekdays, matching the printed 180 pupil days and 90/90 semester split. The month-only June secondary report-card entry is explained in the FAQ without a fabricated June day or month-long event. Administrative FTE surveys, teacher preplanning and postplanning, and Memorial Day after the student year are omitted.
about.updates: The official district PDF, current document folder, calendar-grid PDF, make-up sheet, district News and Live Feed were checked October 15, 2026. The July 21 district notice identifies Challenger 7 as the only modified-calendar school and confirms its July 20 opening. The make-up plan describes a priority process, not activation of a named holiday or an already revised semester-end date. On October 20, the matching two-page district PDF, current printable-calendar listing and district Challenger 7 notice were rechecked. The school’s March 30 modified-calendar announcement separately confirms July 20 for grades 1-6 and July 23 for kindergarten; its dates are described as an exception without adding July events to the regular district calendar. The companion grid and make-up sheet retain their October 15 review dates.
about.disclaimer: This is the regular district calendar, not Challenger 7's modified calendar. Schools provide exam assignments, dismissal times, and the exact June secondary report-card date. Check Brevard Public Schools and your school's announcements for any later calendar changes.

faqs.question: When does Brevard Public Schools start in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The regular district school year begins Monday, August 10, 2026, for students in grades 1–12. Kindergarten starts Thursday, August 13, and Pre-K starts Monday, August 17. Challenger 7 Elementary follows a separate modified calendar.

faqs.question: Does Challenger 7 Elementary follow the regular Brevard school calendar?
faqs.answer: No. Challenger 7 is Brevard Public Schools' only modified-calendar school. Grades 1–6 began July 20, 2026, and kindergarten began July 23. Its breaks and other attendance dates are different. Use the separate 2026–2027 Modified Challenger 7 Calendar rather than the regular district calendar.

faqs.question: Does the regular district calendar apply to every school in Brevard County?
faqs.answer: It applies to Brevard Public Schools campuses that use the regular district calendar, not to every school in the county. Challenger 7 Elementary follows a modified schedule. Charter and private schools may publish their own calendars, so families should confirm with their school.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Brevard Public Schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: The approved regular district calendar lists Wednesday, May 26, 2027, as the last student day. It is also an exam and early-release day, and the second semester ends then. Check your school for exam times and senior-specific end-of-year activities. Graduation dates are not provided in the district calendar.

faqs.question: Are Fridays early release days in Brevard Public Schools?
faqs.answer: The first Friday, August 14, 2026, has regular dismissal. The first early release is Friday, August 21. After that, Fridays with scheduled classes are marked for early release on the published regular district calendar. Some Fridays are holidays or student days off instead. Exam days in December and May also include early release on weekdays other than Friday.

faqs.question: What time is early release in Brevard County schools?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists early-release dates but does not provide dismissal times. Check your school's bell schedule for the correct pickup time. Exam-day schedules may differ from regular Friday early release.

faqs.question: Does Brevard Public Schools have a separate fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The approved 2026–2027 regular district calendar does not list a separate week-long October fall break. Students have no classes on Monday, October 12, for a teacher workday. The next full school-week break is Thanksgiving, November 23–27, 2026.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving Break in Brevard County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break is Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Brevard's winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Students are off from December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027, and return Tuesday, January 5. The official calendar lists December 21–31 as winter holidays, January 1 as a holiday for all, and January 4 as another student/teacher holiday. January 4 is not a teacher workday.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break in Brevard County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 22–26, 2027. Students also have no classes on Friday, March 19, because it is a teacher workday. Including the weekends, students are off March 19–28 and are scheduled to return Monday, March 29. The officially named Spring Break still begins March 22.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are no-school days for Brevard students?
faqs.answer: The regular district calendar lists four student holidays with teacher workdays: September 25 and October 12, 2026, plus February 15 and March 19, 2027. February 15 is Presidents Day. January 4 is also a day off for students, but it is a winter holiday for both students and teachers, not a teacher workday.

faqs.question: Which holidays are no-school days in Brevard Public Schools?
faqs.answer: Labor Day (September 7, 2026), Veterans Day (November 11, 2026), New Year's Day (January 1, 2027), and Martin Luther King Jr. Day (January 18, 2027) are marked as holidays for all. Presidents Day (February 15, 2027) is a student holiday and teacher workday. Thanksgiving, winter and spring breaks are listed separately.

faqs.question: When are Brevard's exam and early-release days in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists Exam Days/Early Release for December 16–18, 2026, and May 24–26, 2027. Each date is an early-release school day. May 26 is also the final student day. Check your school for specific exam schedules and dismissal times.

faqs.question: When does the first semester end in Brevard County?
faqs.answer: The first semester ends Friday, January 8, 2027, which is also an early-release day. Students return from winter break January 5, so the semester continues for four school days after the break. The second semester ends May 26, 2027.

faqs.question: When do grading periods end in Brevard Public Schools?
faqs.answer: The official calendar lists October 13, 2026, as the end of the first nine weeks and March 16, 2027, as the end of the third nine weeks. It separately lists the first-semester end on January 8, 2027, and the second-semester end on May 26, 2027. These dates are not the same as report-card posting dates on FOCUS.

faqs.question: When are elementary interim reports posted on FOCUS?
faqs.answer: Elementary interim reports are scheduled for September 16 and November 30, 2026, and February 17 and April 30, 2027. These are progress-report publication dates, not the quarterly report-card dates. April 30 is also an early-release day.

faqs.question: When are secondary interims and block report cards posted on FOCUS?
faqs.answer: The scheduled dates are September 14 and November 19, 2026, and February 15 and April 28, 2027. February 15 is a student holiday for Presidents Day, but the calendar still lists secondary interim and block report-card publication on FOCUS that day.

faqs.question: When are elementary report cards available on FOCUS?
faqs.answer: Elementary report cards are scheduled to appear on FOCUS October 20, 2026, January 15, 2027, and March 31, 2027. Final elementary report cards are issued May 26 and published on FOCUS May 27.

faqs.question: When are secondary report cards available on FOCUS?
faqs.answer: Secondary report cards are scheduled for October 16, 2026, January 13, 2027, and March 29, 2027. Final secondary report cards are listed for June 2027, but the district calendar gives no specific date. Check FOCUS or your school's announcements for the final release.

faqs.question: What does 'interim ends' mean on Brevard's school calendar?
faqs.answer: It marks the end of a progress-report grading period, not the day families see that interim report in FOCUS. The cutoff dates are September 9 and November 16, 2026, and February 10 and April 23, 2027. Elementary and secondary FOCUS posting dates come later and are listed separately.

faqs.question: How does Brevard Public Schools handle hurricane make-up days?
faqs.answer: The 2026–2027 Make Up Day Priority plan does not assign fixed holiday make-up dates. For one to three missed days, it uses instructional time already built into the first semester. For four or five missed days, the plan calls for extending the first semester into the second. At six missed days, it calls for discussions with the Brevard Federation of Teachers about early-release time. Check district announcements for any actual calendar changes after a closure.

faqs.question: How many school days are in Brevard's 2026–2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The approved regular district calendar lists 180 pupil days, with 90 in each semester. This is the district's published calendar total, not a separate attendance count for every grade or program. Kindergarten and Pre-K start later, and Challenger 7 follows a different calendar.

faqs.question: When are Brevard County high school graduations in 2027?
faqs.answer: The regular district calendar does not list graduation ceremony dates. May 26 is the last student day, not a districtwide graduation date. Check your high school's Class of 2027 graduation announcements for ceremony dates, rehearsals, and ticket information.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Brevard Public Schools 2026–2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The Brevard Public Schools Printable District Calendars page has the 2026–2027 District Calendar PDF, a monthly calendar view, the separate make-up day priority sheet, and Challenger 7's modified calendar. The regular district calendar was approved by the School Board on February 24, 2026. Check district and school announcements for any later changes.
